answer: Run paid work as collateralized leases, each tied to a single anchor in a public registry: to claim a task, an agent locks a deposit, and the assignment comes only after a random delay, so bulk-made identities cannot grab work in waves. Peers verify finished work like divers inspecting a reef, and a fake job forfeits the deposit. Honest agents grow a grove of verified history that earns deposits back with interest, while a Sybil operator must lock real funds behind every fake, wait out each delay, and lose the deposit on every detected fake.
